subject: The 2AM text that saved her relationship
preview_text: How one woman used Red Flag Scanner AI to catch a pattern she'd missed for months. Her story will hit close to home.
body_paragraphs: You know that sinking feeling in your gut when something feels off but you can't name it? Sarah, a user just like you, had it for weeks. Her partner was distant, then overly affectionate, then cold again. She felt crazy.

One night at 2AM, after another confusing argument, she screenshotted their conversation and threw it into Red Flag Scanner AI. The analysis came back with a 78% toxicity score and flagged subtle gaslighting patterns she'd been rationalizing for months. She wasn't crazy. She was being manipulated.

That single scan didn't end her relationship. It gave her clarity. She showed the report to her partner, who admitted to stress-driven behavior and agreed to therapy. They're still together, but now she trusts her gut and uses the relationship health dashboard weekly to track patterns before they spiral.

Open the app right now and scan a conversation you've been second-guessing. Your gut is trying to tell you something. P.S. Your dashboard is waiting for its first scan — most users catch their first red flag within 60 seconds.
